413-1981-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-5870.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-2079-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

6-3301-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-3301-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-3301-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

5147-5170-6132-8175.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

222-527-3899-4885.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4693-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

215-3443-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-7175.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-7175.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

632-3621-4659-5129-5434.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-5434.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
6798-6972-7325.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

792-997-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-997-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

560-997-4550-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-997-4550-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Repeat from step 2

1739-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-1879-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1879-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

3750-6999-7020.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-6999-7020.description:
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ozai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
3750-6999-7020.notes: You can attack with multiple creatures to get infinite red mana.

1651-2573-3875-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2573-3875-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-2573-3875-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

275-1878-2713-3454-6811.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
275-1878-2713-3454-6811.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Transplant Theorist twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

678-2438-4826-6644.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1308-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
1308-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

4214-5189-5332.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4214-5189-5332.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

413-708-2459-3927.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4359-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4359-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-1018-2955.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

413-628-5263.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve both Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 4, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-4812-5145.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding {C}{C}.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.

7-526-2232.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with power 4 or greater that can be cast for {0} due to Hamza.
You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
7-526-2232.description:
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Hamza.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, as well as Cloudstone Curio if the creature isn't an artifact.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Life Finds A Way trigger, creating a copy of a nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature cast in step 1 to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

91-1365-1849-3944-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Mairsil dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1339-2034-3129-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

380-3051-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Dragon.
380-3051-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boneyard Scourge, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Dragon, adding {B}.
When the Dragon dies, Boneyard Scourge triggers, causing you to pay {1}{B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Boneyard Scourge enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Boneyard Scourge.
Repeat.

317-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
317-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from any creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may activate Ghave's first ability an infinite number of times to get infinite Saproling tokens.
